name: Ulteh AI Agents
author: ULTEH

sections.description:
Ulteh AI Agents brings powerful AI chatbots to your WordPress site. Connect your Ulteh account and activate intelligent agents that can handle customer inquiries, provide support, and engage with your visitors 24/7.

Key Features

  • Easy authentication with your Ulteh account
  • Select and activate AI agents directly from WordPress admin
  • Real-time chat widget integration
  • Multiple agent management
  • No coding required
  • Responsive design for all devices
  • GDPR compliant

How It Works

  1. Install and activate the plugin
  2. Log in with your Ulteh account credentials
  3. Choose an AI agent from your account
  4. Activate the agent to display the chat widget on your site

The plugin connects to Ulteh’s service to provide AI-powered chat functionality. By using this plugin, you agree to Ulteh’s Terms of Service and Privacy Policy.

External Service Usage

This plugin connects to Ulteh’s external API service (https://ulteh.com) to:
* Authenticate users
* Retrieve available AI agents
* Load the chat widget script

For more information, please review:
* Ulteh Terms of Service: https://ulteh.com/terms
* Ulteh Privacy Policy: https://ulteh.com/privacy
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to /wp-content/plugins/ulteh-ai-agents/ directory, or install through WordPress plugins screen
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress
  3. Navigate to ‘AI Agent’ in the WordPress admin menu
  4. Log in with your Ulteh account credentials
  5. Select and activate an AI agent
sections.faq:
Do I need an Ulteh account?

Yes, you need an active Ulteh account to use this plugin. You can sign up at https://ulteh.com/register

Is this plugin free?

The plugin is free to install. Ulteh account plans may vary.

Can I use multiple agents?

You can manage multiple agents but only one can be active on your site at a time.

Is the chat widget customizable?

Chat widget customization is managed through your Ulteh account dashboard.

Does this work with any WordPress theme?

Yes, the plugin works with any WordPress theme.
